evidence: Changes src/common/args.cpp, src/common/args.h, and src/init.cpp to introduce NEGATE_TO_EMPTY and overhaul negated option parsing.
rationale: Fixes hazardous side effects across the node's argument parsing infrastructure when configuration options are negated. Without this, options like -notorcontrol connect to 0.0.0.0:9051 and notify hooks attempt to execute a binary named "0".
